what: The stock this kit is exact against, pinned: the upstream package (songlab-cal/gpn at one commit; the git archive of that commit is carried in stock/), the library stack, and the released GPN-Star checkpoints (Hugging Face repository, revision, per-file bytes and sha256). Read by stock/check_pins.py.

pinned_stack.tested_on: python 3.13, torch 2.13.0+cu130 (CUDA 13.0, cuDNN 9.20), triton 3.7.1, transformers 5.15.0, accelerate 1.15.0, huggingface_hub 1.31.0, safetensors 0.8.0, numpy 2.5.3, zarr 3.3.0, gpn 0.9.0 from git @ 6f28c81bcbfe7d65cb6d8ece9ce88f87ca583791; NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, driver 580.95.05; TF32 off (the PyTorch defaults: torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 False, float32_matmul_precision 'highest'); weights not in the image (a record of where the numbers were taken; nothing reads or compares it)

numerics.stock: fp32 weights and activations (config.json torch_dtype float32; from_pretrained with no dtype argument), eval mode, the forward under transformers Trainer.predict (torch.no_grad, no autocast), scaled_dot_product_attention restricted to the math backend by the model code, TF32 off (the package sets no TF32 or matmul-precision flag: PyTorch defaults)

weights.root: the Hugging Face cache under HF_HOME (upstream's own location: hub/models--songlab--gpn-star-<name>/snapshots/<commit>/); --model-path takes the repository id with --model-revision <commit>, or the snapshot directory

weights_layout.form: HF cache: <HF_HOME>/hub/models--songlab--<repo>/snapshots/<commit>/ with refs/main = the commit; read with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
weights_layout.files_read_at_load: config.json, model.safetensors (AutoModelForMaskedLM.from_pretrained); phylo_dist/in_clade.npy and phylo_dist/pairwise.npy via config.json phylo_dist_path (the model's phylogenetic-distance tables); calibration_table/*.parquet is not read by gpn star vep|logits|embedding
weights_layout.manifest: python -I stock/check_pins.py --weights <HF_HOME> --variant <key>|all checks every pinned file under <HF_HOME>/hub/models--songlab--<name>/snapshots/<commit>/ against the digests above (sha256 and size); the files in required_files must be present

entry_point.cli: gpn star vep --input-path <variants table | dataset id> --msa-path <alignment zarr> --window-size <int> --model-path <repo id | snapshot dir> --output-path <out.parquet> [--model-revision <commit>] [--split test] [checkpoint options] [Transformers prediction options, e.g. --per-device-eval-batch-size N --dataloader-num-workers N]

options.--window-size: required (int; even and positive for vep|logits: src/gpn/scoring.py L135-141)
options.checkpoint options: CheckpointArguments (src/gpn/arguments.py): checkpoint_batch_size None = direct, non-resumable run
options.Transformers prediction options: every transformers.TrainingArguments field as a flag (src/gpn/cli.py L16-19); batch size = per_device_eval_batch_size, loader workers = dataloader_num_workers (TrainingArguments defaults when not given)

entry_point.load: MLMforVEPModel(model_path, model_revision): register_auto_classes('star'); self.model = AutoModelForMaskedLM.from_pretrained(model_path, revision=model_revision); self.model.eval() — src/gpn/star/inference.py L38-46; logits: MLMforLogitsModel L99-116 (same load); embedding: ModelCenterEmbedding L151-164 (AutoModel.from_pretrained)
entry_point.patch_target: the wrapper's .model attribute (a GPNStarForMaskedLM; its .model is the GPNStarModel encoder: src/gpn/star/model.py L1186-1197)
entry_point.forward: Trainer(model=<wrapper>, args=<prediction TrainingArguments>).predict(test_dataset=dataset).predictions — src/gpn/inference.py L124 (construction), L52 (predict); invariants applied to the arguments: do_predict, dataloader_drop_last False, dataloader_in_order True, remove_unused_columns False (L68-78)
entry_point.input: vep: columns chrom, pos (one-based), ref, alt (src/gpn/star/inference.py L235-237); logits: chrom, pos (L321-323); embedding: chrom, start, end; a local file by suffix .parquet .csv[.gz] .tsv[.gz] .vcf[.gz] (src/gpn/cli.py L26-38, src/gpn/data.py L13-35) else a Hugging Face dataset id loaded with datasets.load_dataset(path, split=--split) (src/gpn/data.py L57-67)
entry_point.msa: --msa-path: a zarr store opened read-only with zarr.open(path, mode='r'), one array per chromosome keyed by chromosome name, sliced [start:end] over the first n_species columns (src/gpn/star/data.py L22-29, L40); several stores can be summed by species count (find_directory_sum_paths, src/gpn/star/utils.py)
entry_point.output: one Parquet file at --output-path, written atomically: vep -> column 'score' (src/gpn/star/inference.py L298-299); logits -> columns A, C, G, T (L350-351); embedding -> embedding_0..embedding_<d-1> (L393-395); row order = input order (src/gpn/inference.py L154-158, L330)

stock_environment.what: a stock process has GPNSTAR_OPT unset and no TF32 override in the environment; the package itself reads no GPN-specific environment variable for inference
